declaration.goal: Crawl ahead by 0.3 to 0.5 m, keeping within 0.2 m of the start line and within 20 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c2 and c3 carry sines near 2.1 Hz with c3 lagging c2 by 200 deg, or at 2.2 Hz with lag 225 deg, or at 2.1 Hz with lag 225 deg and c4 in phase with c2 at amplitude 0.5, THE system SHALL reach x of at least 0.27 m.

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: T1 (2.1 Hz, lag 200, a4 0): x 0.294, y 0.113, heading 10.6 deg, inside P1 range? no, 0.294 is above 0.27 so P1 holds. T2 (2.2 Hz, lag 225): x 0.240, heading -27 deg, P2 range 0.2-0.4 holds but worse than 2.1 Hz. T3 (a4 0.5): x 0.312, y 0.195, heading 24.9 deg; P3 holds in range but violates heading and sits at the y limit. c4 in phase with c2 adds x and heading left. No trial meets all of x>=0.3, y<0.2, |heading|<20 yet.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c2 and c3 carry 2.1 Hz sines with c3 lagging by 210 deg and c4 carries 0.3 times the c2 sine, THE system SHALL reach x of at least 0.3 m with heading magnitude under 20 deg and y under 0.2 m.

words.text: T4 (lag 210, a4 0.3): x 0.332, y 0.199, heading 28.8, x in range but heading P2 fails. T5 (lag 225, a4 0.3): x 0.303, y 0.142, heading 9.0, meets all goal limits, thin margin on x. T6 (lag 200, a4 0.3): x 0.284, y 0.275, heading 44, P4 fails. So lag 225 with a4 0.3 is a valid point; lag below 215 turns the body too far.
